extensionDescription.message: Replaces the user's homepage with a session based bookmarks manager.
extensionDescription.description: Puts bookmarks where they're most useful - the default view in each new tab.

openInTab.description: Opens bookmark in a new tab within the current window.

openInWindow.description: Opens bookmark in a new window.

openInPrivateWindow.description: Opens bookmark in a new private window.

editBookmark.description: Edit the bookmark label and url.

cutBookmark.description: Remove the bookmark and place it on the clipboard.

copyBookmark.description: Copy the bookmark onto the clipboard.

pasteBookmark.description: Insert the clipboard contents at this location.

createBookmark.description: Create a new bookmark from the selected tab.

contextMenuLabel.description: How context menus per item are accessed.

contextMenuOptionBoth.description: Available via right click or visible on the item.

rootFolderLabel.description: Which bookmarks folder should HomeBooks manage.

openFolderInCurrentWindow.description: Opens all bookmarks in the folder into the current window.

openFolderInNewWindow.description: Opens all bookmarks in the folder into a new window.

openFolderInPrivateWindow.description: Opens all bookmarks in the folder into a private window.

createBookmarkInFolder.description: Add a new bookmark at the top of this folder.

deleteFolder.description: Delete the folder and all child nodes.

cutFolder.description: Remove the folder and its children and place it on the clipboard.

copyFolder.description: Copy the folder and its children onto the clipboard.

pasteFolder.description: Create the clipboard contents into this folder.

createItemModalTitleBookmark.description: Title for the create bookmark modal.

createItemModalTitleFolder.description: Title for the create folder modal.

createFormTitleLabel.description: Label for title field in create item form.

createFormUrlLabel.description: Label for URL field in create bookmark form.

createFormSubmit.description: Submit button for create item form.

createFormCancel.description: Cancel button for create item form.

createFormGlobalError.description: Summary shown after a failed submit when validation errors exist.

createFormUrlInvalid.description: Validation when URL is not parseable.

createFormParentRequired.description: Validation when parent folder is missing.

popupAddBookmarkTitle.description: Heading for extension popup when adding a bookmark.

popupLoading.description: Shown in the toolbar popup while settings and tab info load.

popupRestrictedTitle.message: Can't add a bookmark for this tab
popupRestrictedTitle.description: Popup heading when the active tab is an extension or browser page.

popupRestrictedExplanation.message: Browser and extension pages don't use a normal web address. Open a regular website, then use this popup or HomeBooks to save it.
popupRestrictedExplanation.description: Short explanation under the restricted-tab popup title.

popupVersionLabel.description: Label before the extension version number on the popup info screen.

popupAboutHeading.description: Section heading on the popup info screen.

popupOpenSettings.description: Button that focuses HomeBooks and opens the settings panel.

folderEmptyBody.message: No bookmarks here yet. Drag a tab over from the right or {{createLink}}.
folderEmptyBody.description: Empty-folder copy; keep the {{createLink}} token so a control can be inlined.

folderEmptyCreateLink.description: Label for the inline create-bookmark control in folderEmptyBody.

tabsWindowNoValidTabs.message: No valid tabs in this window.
tabsWindowNoValidTabs.description: Empty state when a browser window has no tabs with bookmarkable URLs.
